77978.desc: A Love Letter to the Land. Mist settles silently into the valleys below while the escarpment rises above it, creating the illusion of distant snow-covered hills. As the sun climbs, the fog slowly lifts and another day on the mountain begins. Mountain living is something special. It isn't for everyone. But those who embrace it rarely want to leave. There is a peace here that is difficult to articulate until you experience it for yourself. The air feels different. The seasons are more pronounced. The silence is punctuated by the extraordinary calls of resident lyrebirds - ancient, almost prehistoric sounds echoing through the surrounding forest.
